These can be [[Aged Eggroll 1]] with a 33% chance, [[Aged Eggroll 2]] with a 34% chance and [[Aged Eggroll 3]] with a 33% chance. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Even the elderly?!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 15 2.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 16 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} {{QuoteBox|ESPECIALLY THE ELDERLY!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 15 3.ogg|[[Nerd Duck (Narrator)|Nerd Duck]] dialogue on Wave 16 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Grandmother Ducky''' was an enemy which appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has a decent amount of health and slightly fast speed. Upon death, it will spawn three aged eggrolls, which can be the [[Aged Eggroll 1]], [[Aged Eggroll 2]] and [[Aged Eggroll 3]]. These enemies will then summon a [[Fat Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Fat Ducky]] upon death. ==Logbook Description== "''Grandma Ducky is the sweetest, most endearing duck around. Full of love and compassion for all of the ducklings, she’ll spend countless hours telling them stories and baking them homemade buckwheat cookies. One by one she’ll sit each duckling on her lap and preen their little heads before sending them off to explore the world.''" ==Appearance== The '''Grandmother Ducky''' is a regular, yellow duck with an orange beak, orange flippers and grey hair, which represents its age. It wears light yellow and pink knitted clothes, and grey glasses. It uses a stroller to help it walk. It holds two wooden knitting needles and a green yarn. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *As the '''Grandmother Ducky''' summons three eggrolls upon death, it is quite a dangerous enemy. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful at killing all the eggrolls summoned at once. **Single target towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Turret]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can also be helpful. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1GrandMotherDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGrandmotherDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer -
